<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 2 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Book 2 ==

== Biography ==

The Captain commands Glinda's private Body Guard, a troop of neatly uniformed soldiers armed with swords and spears who march with notable skill and precision. Upon encountering the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman, the Captain recognizes them at once and greets them with respectful salutations, informing them that Glinda already awaits their audience within her palace. The Captain then leads the visitors toward the palace. Later, the Captain and three soldiers form part of the guard aboard the Gump alongside Glinda, Princess Ozma, and their companions during the flight to the Emerald City. When the Gump lands in the courtyard, the Captain and the soldiers seize Jinjur, locking chains upon her wrists, an act that ends the Army of Revolt's war. The Captain subsequently marches safely through the city streets as its gates are opened, following the conquest of Jinjur and the restoration of Princess Ozma to the throne.
</div>
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 6 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Book 6 ==

== Biography ==

The Captain leads a group of captives through a crowd to a range at the center of a clearing, beside which stands a butcher block with a large cleaver. He wakes a sleeping figure addressed as "your Majesty," announcing, "Here are prisoners." When questioned about a girl among the captives, the Captain states he found her in the forest and brought her back as a prisoner.
</div>
